scope.description: What was searched: a call, the calls in a function, or the calls to a callee.

offset.description: Index of the first returned call site.

callee.description: Callee: module!name for imports and late-bound imports, a function name, or the pointer for indirect calls.

calleeKind.description: import, function, dynamic (GetProcAddress / dlsym pointer), virtual_exact (a virtual call with one implementation, resolved through RTTI), virtual_possible (one of several implementations, listed in Callee) or indirect.

tailCall.description: A jump to the callee (tail call) rather than a call.

signatureKnown.description: The callee's signature is known (parameter names, count and constant decoding); otherwise the arguments are the registers / stack slots set just before the call.

display.description: The call with its arguments, e.g. CreateFileW(L"config.ini", GENERIC_READ, ...).

name.description: Parameter name from the API signature; null for callees without one.

type.description: Parameter type (str, int, ptr, an enumeration or flags name...); null without a signature.

location.description: Where it is passed: rcx, rdi, xmm0, [rsp+20h], [esp+4h], ecx; ARM64 x0-x7, s0-s7 / d0-d7, stack.

kind.description: immediate, string, address, name, result (of an earlier call), global (contents of a variable) or unknown.

text.description: The value as shown in the call: decoded flags, quoted string, name, ? when unknown.

address.description: The address (VA) for strings, addresses, names and globals.

derivation.description: How it was derived: the instructions from the call back to the definition, or why it is unknown.

notes.description: Coverage notes: limits reached, what is not analyzed.
